Tanishaa Mukerji criticizes women involved with married men

Actress Tanishaa Mukerji has made a statement criticizing women who are involved with married men. In a social media post, she stated that such women are not feminists but are the biggest enemies of women. Mukerji described these women as 'inferior' or 'cheap'.
